export_build:
import hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'prototype-game/tests/e2e')
import device_flow
key, apk = device_flow.prepare_export()
apk = Path(apk)
manifest = json.loads(apk.with_name('manifest.json').read_text())
assert manifest['schema'] == 1 and manifest['key'] == key
assert manifest['package'] == 'com.lila.prototype.e2e' and manifest['release_beacon_excluded'] is True
assert apk.stat().st_size >= 100000
assert hashlib.sha256(apk.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == manifest['apk_sha256']
print('FM_EXPORT_KEY=' + key, flush=True)
